تستذنبون (form X)
# تَسْتَذْنِبُونَ (tastaḏnibūna) /tas.tað.ni.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
# تُسْتَذْنَبُونَ (tustaḏnabūna) /tus.tað.na.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
